input: Submit my travel essay to a literary journal

gold.taskTitle: Submit travel essay to a literary journal
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to submit a completed or in-progress travel essay to a literary journal for publication consideration.

questions.title: Is your essay fully written and ready to submit?
questions.description: Understand whether the essay is drafted, needs revision, or is still being written.

questions.title: Do you have a specific journal already in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has already identified a target journal or needs help selecting one.

questions.title: What is the word count of your essay?
questions.description: Determine the length of the essay, which affects which journals accept it.

questions.title: What is the central theme or destination of the essay?
questions.description: Understand the subject matter to help match the essay to the right publication.

questions.title: Have you submitted to any literary journals before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's familiarity with the submission process and requirements.

questions.title: Is there a deadline you are working toward?
questions.description: Identify any time pressure that would affect how the plan is prioritized.

questions.title: Do you want simultaneous submissions or one journal at a time?
questions.description: Clarify the user's submission strategy, as some journals prohibit simultaneous submissions.
